About this item

  • 【Versatile Tasks Butcher Knife Set】Butcher knife set includes: 6" bone chopper knife,6" meat cleaver knife, 5.9" viking knife, 5.5" cleaver knife, 6.7" fillet knife, 6" dividing knife, 5.5" paring knife and knife bag. Suitable to handle a variety of tasks such as slicing, chopping, dicing, mincing and cutting tough vegetables, meats, bone, fish, they are suitable for BBQ, hiking and camping.
  • 【High-end Stainless Steel】Each knife of this kitchen knife set is constructed from premium high carbon stainless steel, the blade is forged using a stonewashed and hammer finish treatment, 58+2 high hardness, wear-resistant, and non-sticking. High quality material which makes its blade more solid and sharper for precise and efficient cutting and gives you a better usage experience.
  • 【Masterful Forged Craftsmanship】Razor-sharp and powerful are the characteristics of the butcher knife, bringing the edge to a razor-sharp 16° degrees per side V-shaped cutting edge to achieve the best balance of hardness, durability, rust resistance and sharpness, maximum cutting performance.
  • 【Ergonomic Comfortable Wood Handle】Butcher chef knives with ergonomic walnut wood handle, which is well-balanced and durable, full tang design with three rivets and a seamless transition from blade to handle retain the utmost comfort and safety, ensures optimal stability and balance that helps reduce hand fatigue.
  • 【Portable Kitchen Knife Set】All knives can be neatly organized in a durable and portable bag, making them easy to carry for outdoor camping, hiking, and cooking. HOSHANHO butcher knife set is a great gift choice for occasions such as Thanksgiving, Christmas, Halloween, weddings, birthdays, housewarming, and anniversaries.

    op-Notch Butcher Knife Set – Essential for Any Serious Cook!
    Reviewed in the United States on February 20, 2025
    Size: 6"
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I recently purchased the HOSHANHO Butcher Knife Set and am absolutely blown away by the quality and versatility of these knives! This set is a game-changer for anyone who loves to cook, especially for those who enjoy preparing meats or doing any heavy-duty chopping.

    Pros:

    Incredible Sharpness & Durability: The bone chopper knife, meat cleaver, and viking knife all come incredibly sharp right out of the box. They cut through bones, tough cuts of meat, and vegetables with ease, requiring minimal effort and ensuring clean cuts every time. The high-quality steel used in these knives guarantees they’ll maintain their edge for a long time, even with heavy use.

    Heavy Duty & Well-Balanced: These knives feel solid and sturdy in hand. The weight is perfect for cutting through thick bones and dense meat without feeling unwieldy or awkward. The balanced design provides comfort, even when used for longer periods.

    Perfect for Heavy-Duty Tasks: Whether I’m breaking down large cuts of meat, chopping through bones, or preparing food for a BBQ, these knives are up to the task. They handle all these tasks with ease, making my kitchen prep a lot smoother and faster.

    Beautiful & Functional Design: The knives are not only functional but also beautifully designed. The craftsmanship is evident, and they look great in my kitchen. The ergonomic handles offer a comfortable grip, reducing hand fatigue even after extended use.

    Great Set for Various Cooking Needs: From heavy-duty butcher tasks to general kitchen prep, this set is versatile and covers everything I need. Whether I’m cooking at home or taking them along for a camping BBQ, this set is perfect for all occasions.

    Perfect for Professionals and Home Cooks Alike:

    As someone who loves both home cooking and outdoor cooking, I can confidently say that this knife set will elevate your kitchen tools. It’s a must-have for anyone who wants reliable, sharp, and durable knives that can handle tough cutting jobs.

    Great Value for Money:

    Considering the quality and functionality of these knives, this set is an incredible value. It would make an excellent addition to any kitchen, especially for those who love to cook meat-heavy dishes.

    I’m thoroughly impressed with the HOSHANHO Butcher Knife Set and would love to explore more products from this brand in the future. If you’re looking for a top-tier knife set that’s durable, sharp, and beautiful, this one is definitely worth it!

    Thanks for offering such a high-quality product – I can’t wait to see what else HOSHANHO has to offer!

    5 out of 5 stars
    Surprisingly well build, solid feel and good balance
    Reviewed in the United States on June 28, 2026
    Size: 6.5"
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Let me start with the case. Right out of the box, I was impressed. It's got a nice solid weight to it. The material feels really well made, the stitching looks good, and it doesn't feel cheap. It honestly feels like somebody took pride in putting this set together.

    Now for the knives. The first thing I noticed was how balanced they are. As soon as I picked one up, it just felt right in my hand. The walnut handles look great, they're solid, and the knives are scary sharp right out of the box. I was honestly surprised.

    One thing I did notice is they have a 15-degree edge, so when it's time to sharpen them, I'll keep that same angle. Other than that, I'll just hand wash them with soap and water, dry them right away, and I think they'll last a long time.

    I'm not a professional cook by any means. I'm just a guy who loves to barbecue. I smoke briskets, spatchcock chickens, make birria, trim a lot of meat, and I'm always cooking on my Pit Boss. For the kind of cooking I do, these knives are awesome. I wasn't expecting them to feel this good for what I paid. They honestly exceeded my expectations

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Premium Cleaver – Powerful, Sharp, Built to Last

    This cleaver is seriously impressive. The grip is perfect, and the handle feels solid and comfortable in the hand — no slipping, even with longer use. The design is also beautiful — it looks like a proper premium kitchen tool.

    The blade is made from strong, durable steel and has a great weight to it. It’s heavy enough to give power and control, but still precise when cutting.

    👉 And the sharpness…

    This thing is razor sharp — honestly, you could shave with it if you wanted (not recommended 😄). It cuts through meat effortlessly.

    My wife even managed to cut through bones with it, and she’s half my size — that tells you everything about how effective it is.

    Another big plus: very easy to clean. A quick rinse and it’s done — no hassle.

    This is the kind of tool where once you buy it, you’re set for years. Just sharpen it occasionally and it will keep performing like new.

    ⚠️ One warning: be careful — it’s extremely sharp.

    Overall: premium quality, powerful, reliable. Highly recommended.

About this Item

  • 【Versatile Tasks Butcher Knife Set】Butcher knife set includes: 6" bone chopper knife,6" meat cleaver knife, 5.9" viking knife, 5.5" cleaver knife, 6.7" fillet knife, 6" dividing knife, 5.5" paring knife and knife bag. Suitable to handle a variety of tasks such as slicing, chopping, dicing, mincing and cutting tough vegetables, meats, bone, fish, they are suitable for BBQ, hiking and camping.
  • 【High-end Stainless Steel】Each knife of this kitchen knife set is constructed from premium high carbon stainless steel, the blade is forged using a stonewashed and hammer finish treatment, 58+2 high hardness, wear-resistant, and non-sticking. High quality material which makes its blade more solid and sharper for precise and efficient cutting and gives you a better usage experience.
  • 【Masterful Forged Craftsmanship】Razor-sharp and powerful are the characteristics of the butcher knife, bringing the edge to a razor-sharp 16° degrees per side V-shaped cutting edge to achieve the best balance of hardness, durability, rust resistance and sharpness, maximum cutting performance.
  • 【Ergonomic Comfortable Wood Handle】Butcher chef knives with ergonomic walnut wood handle, which is well-balanced and durable, full tang design with three rivets and a seamless transition from blade to handle retain the utmost comfort and safety, ensures optimal stability and balance that helps reduce hand fatigue.
  • 【Portable Kitchen Knife Set】All knives can be neatly organized in a durable and portable bag, making them easy to carry for outdoor camping, hiking, and cooking. HOSHANHO butcher knife set is a great gift choice for occasions such as Thanksgiving, Christmas, Halloween, weddings, birthdays, housewarming, and anniversaries.
